key_insight: Genetic algorithms optimize interpretable spatial descriptors to balance local-response prediction error against descriptor size.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps identify where detailed image structure or compact regional summaries are needed to predict local spectra and hysteresis loops.
method: Benchmark regression models and examine spatial attribution with SHAP maps.
Evaluate how image patch size and compression affect prediction accuracy and descriptor dimensionality.
Evolve Cartesian or polar spatial partitions with mean, minimum, and maximum pooling.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes regression benchmarking and descriptor trade-off evaluations but reports no numerical performance results.
watch_item: Extension to molecules and solids requires domain-specific genetic algorithm rules that are not established here.
paper_title: Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
